bullets.text: Seven people were killed and over 100 injured after two trains collided outside Giza, Egypt, prompting a presidential investigation.
Three men were executed in Iran for their alleged involvement in 'armed unrest' during anti-government protests earlier this year.
Paraguay's former president, Santiago Peña, has been charged and placed under house arrest following a banking crisis that left millions unable to access their money.
A new housing model aims to provide stable homes for older, single women experiencing housing insecurity, with hopes it will become a widespread solution.
A 51-year-old man has been charged with murder following the alleged stabbing of a delivery driver in Melbourne.
Support for the Labor government has significantly dropped, with Prime Minister Anthony Albanese experiencing a major hit in recent polls.
Apple has reportedly saved $2.7 billion in taxes by shifting its profit booking to Singapore, making the city-state its primary tax shelter over Ireland.
Markets are reacting negatively to the Democratic party's recent electoral successes, with investors concerned that the shift in power could hinder the growth of the AI industry.
China's banking system is facing challenges due to indebted tycoons, highlighting the lingering effects of years of aggressive capitalism.
